text.p: -- Lehman Bros. raised FY97 estimates on Pairgan Technologies Inc to $0.81/shr from $0.78 and increased FY98 estimates to $1.05 from $1.03 (corrects from "$2.26 from $2.20").
-- Noted Pairgain reported Q1 EPS, excluding charges associated with acquisition, of $0.19, beating estimate of $0.17. After charges, EPS was $0.15 vs $0.09.
-- Noted revenues in Q197 reached $70.7 million, up 75 pct from the year ago qtr. Gross margins were 49.4 pct while oper margins rose to 19.8 pct from 19.4 pct.
-- Reiterating outperform recommendation based on view PairGain is likely to experience compound earnings growth of more than 60 pct from 1995 to 1998 and 35 percent over the longer term.
